reason: the red-team lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: red-team lens, medium: The awk block that extracts `_classify_reasons` exits the function scope on the first `^}` at column 0; any top-level closing brace (e.g. from an outer compound command) inside `_router_rc_classify` would stop collection early, silently dropping reason values that follow it, so the DSEND-1 comment-completeness check can pass while real values go uncounted. (tests/unit/route-loop-terminated-reasons-test.sh: "    /^}/ { in_fn=0 }"; fix: test)

red-team lens, medium: If both grep and awk extractions silently return nothing (e.g. a quoting-style change in route.sh defeats the regex), `_required` is empty, the DSEND-1 membership loop iterates zero times, `_missing` stays unset, and this line fires green — the comment can then say anything and the test reports pass. (tests/unit/route-loop-terminated-reasons-test.sh: "    assert_pass "[DSEND-1] every required reason value is listed in the TERMINATED_REASON comment""; fix: test)

red-team lens, low: DSLOCK-3 hardcodes the abbreviated base commit hash `6a07fa8e`; if this worktree is rebased or cloned without that commit reachable, `git diff 6a07fa8e..HEAD` emits a fatal error captured by `2>&1 || true`, making `_dslock3_diff` non-empty and failing the assertion for a reason unrelated to the file's content, indistinguishable from a real change. (tests/unit/route-loop-terminated-reasons-test.sh: "_dslock3_base="6a07fa8e""; fix: test)

red-team lens, low: The new `elif` branch for `no_done_sentinel` and `router_out_of_turns` emits `build.discrepancy.detected` but omits the `warn` to stderr that the `done_sentinel` branch emits; operators monitoring stderr for discrepancy signals will silently miss these two end-reason cases. (plugins/agent/build/lib/summary.sh: "    elif [[ ( "$terminated_reason" == "no_done_sentinel" || \"; fix: code)
